'''2010 US East Nationals Brian Herold LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Johnny Reb Senate
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
